description: This file contains utility functions for handling messages, content conversion, and tool integration within a Google Generative AI chat model context, including message author mapping, content transformation, and response mapping.

classes.name: AIMessage
classes.description: Represents an AI message with content, tool calls, and additional metadata.

classes.name: AIMessageChunk
classes.description: Represents a chunk of an AI message, used for streaming or chunked responses.

classes.name: BaseMessage
classes.description: Base class for messages, providing common properties and methods.

classes.name: ChatMessage
classes.description: Represents a chat message with role and content.

classes.name: ToolMessage
classes.description: Represents a message involving a tool call.

classes.name: MessageContent
classes.description: Content of a message, can be string or complex object.

classes.name: MessageContentComplex
classes.description: Complex message content with various types like text, media, tool use, etc.

classes.name: ChatGeneration
classes.description: Represents a chat message generation result.

classes.name: ChatGenerationChunk
classes.description: Chunked part of a chat generation.

classes.name: ChatResult
classes.description: Final chat response with generations and metadata.

methods.name: getMessageAuthor
methods.description: Determines the author of a message based on its type and role.

methods.name: convertAuthorToRole
methods.description: Maps a message author string to a role recognized by Google Generative AI.

methods.name: messageContentMedia
methods.description: Converts message content with media into Part format.

methods.name: inferToolNameFromPreviousMessages
methods.description: Infers the tool name from previous messages based on tool calls.

methods.name: _getStandardContentBlockConverter
methods.description: Creates a converter for standard content blocks supporting multimodal models.

methods.name: _convertLangChainContentToPart
methods.description: Converts complex message content into Part format, handling various content types.

methods.name: convertMessageContentToParts
methods.description: Converts message content into parts suitable for Google Generative AI, including tool responses.

methods.name: convertBaseMessagesToContent
methods.description: Converts an array of base messages into content array for Google Generative AI, handling roles and merging.

methods.name: mapGenerateContentResultToChatResult
methods.description: Maps a content generation response to a ChatResult object.

methods.name: convertResponseContentToChatGenerationChunk
methods.description: Converts a response into a chunk of chat generation, supporting streaming.

methods.name: convertToGenerativeAITools
methods.description: Converts internal tool representations into Google Generative AI function declaration format.
